title: Independent audit of the frozen-rule scalar retention plug-in CLT (O6)
statement: Independent adversarial audit of RETENTION-PLUGIN-CLT-FROZEN-SCALAR and RETENTION-PLUGIN-COVERAGE-DOOR3 at score-oracle-robustness@a5f905e. Verdict: verified with hardened assumptions. O6.1 (RSS identity, 0/0 := 0, library agreement), O6.2 (delta-method CLT with psi = ((1 - eta) S^2 - (S - c_Z)^2)/v and the numerator-denominator covariance form) and O6.3 (a.s. consistency of the plug-in influence variance through within-cell moments of order <= 4) hold as stated; the empty-cell transfer is complete and is replaced by applying the delta method to the estimator's own everywhere-defined functional. Hardening (H1): the sigma^2 = 0 characterisation is correct as a root-set statement but its 'at most two atoms per cell' reading and the sentence 'an atomless cell of positive probability implies (A4)' fail at eta = 0, where the root equation is the identity and every law with vanishing cell means has psi = 0 (CE-O6-ETA-ZERO-MULTIATOM-VARIANCE-001; atomless probe); for 0 < eta < 1 the roots c_b/(1 -+ sqrt(1 - eta)) with forced upper weight eta/(2(1 + sqrt(1 - eta))) give explicit exact sigma^2 = 0 laws (eta = 3/4), in which eta_hat >= eta for every sample. (H2): the retention reading requires the evaluation law to be P_theta0; under another law the interval estimates an uncentred moment ratio. Numerically: closed-form cell boundaries (quadratic roots of the classifier logit) and Gaussian-CDF cell moments reproduce the recorded door3 references to rounding and the researcher's artifact to <= 2e-15; fresh-seed coverage (4000 replicates) replicates O6.7; the rung n_per_class = 300 under-covers to 0.896 at n = 100; in both sigma^2 = 0 laws the Wald interval is conservative, not liberal. Literature: the method is textbook prior art; no direct statement of the fixed-partition uncentred correlation-ratio CLT with this influence function was located (search gap, not novelty).
assumptions: source frozen at score-oracle-robustness@a5f905e (packet handoff b9a42c3); the researcher's instrument, transcript and plan file were not read; the researcher's artifacts and literature audit were opened only after the audit's own numbers and table existed, as comparison material

the independent instrument py/audit_score_oracle_retention_uncertainty.py does not import, extend or copy py/score_oracle_retention_uncertainty.py; claim-level identities are fractions.Fraction; population references are closed-form Gaussian-CDF differences plus two independent quadratures; Monte Carlo seeds are fresh (SeedSequence 20260906)
the imported hypotheses of FI-QUANT-IDENTITY and PROXY-TRUE-RETAINED-FI were rechecked for the frozen map q o s_hat, not re-proved
scope is O6.1-O6.5 and the two claim nodes; vector scores, refitted rules, weights, bootstrap comparisons and any public API are flagged, not chased
no src/ or public API change is authorized by this audit

role: independent publication-grade verification and hardening of O6; authorizes removal of the 'not independently audited' notes, not a library uncertainty API
warning: Verified does not mean deployable: the interval is conditional on a frozen rule, needs an oracle-score evaluation sample from the reference law, has no finite-sample guarantee (0.90-0.92 coverage at n = 100), and is unsupported (conservative, width O(1/n)) when sigma^2 = 0. Nothing here covers vector scores, refitted rules or weights.
